question: For each user session in the activity log table, identify the number of events that occurred before the first '/detail' click or '/complete' conversion, counting only events that have a non-empty search type. Find the sessions with the minimum count of such pre-click/pre-conversion events. If multiple sessions share this minimum count, include all of them in the results. Return each qualifying session along with the corresponding path and search type.
sql:
WITH first_click AS (
    SELECT session, MIN(stamp) as first_click_stamp
    FROM activity_log
    WHERE path IN ('/detail', '/complete')
    GROUP BY session
),
pre_click_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        fc.session,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN al.stamp IS NOT NULL 
                   AND al.search_type IS NOT NULL 
                   AND al.search_type != '' THEN 1 END) as pre_click_count
    FROM first_click fc
    LEFT JOIN activity_log al ON al.session = fc.session AND al.stamp < fc.first_click_stamp
    GROUP BY fc.session
),
min_count AS (
    SELECT MIN(pre_click_count) as min_val FROM pre_click_counts
),
qualifying_sessions AS (
    SELECT fc.session FROM pre_click_counts fc WHERE fc.pre_click_count = (SELECT min_val FROM min_count)
),
first_click_info AS (
    SELECT fc.session, al.path, al.search_type
    FROM first_click fc
    JOIN activity_log al ON al.session = fc.session AND al.stamp = fc.first_click_stamp
)
SELECT qs.session, 
       STRING_AGG(path, ',') as paths,
       STRING_AGG(search_type, ',') as search_types
FROM qualifying_sessions qs
JOIN first_click_info fci ON fci.session = qs.session
GROUP BY qs.session
ORDER BY qs.session
